deadline.value: International applicants: March 26, 2027 (domestic May 28, 2027). If your intended supervisor is in Psychology, apply by January 8, 2027.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the official pages checked

supervisor.value: Entry to the program requires securing a supervisor first.
supervisor.quote: Entry to the program first requires applicants to secure a supervisor

funding.value: Students receive an annual funding package (WGRS, GTA, supervisor stipend) guaranteed for 12 terms (4 years) of PhD, or 15 terms for transfer and direct entry, if progression requirements are met.
funding.quote: Guaranteed Funding Duration (academic progression and eligibility requirements must be maintained) | PhD Students: 12 terms (4 years)

entry_route.value: Honours or Masters degree in a related field; direct-entry PhD applicants need at least 85% over the final two years, and applicants without a degree from a recognized university start in the MSc.
entry_route.quote: Honors or Masters degree in Neuroscience or in a related field with a strong research component | Direct Entry PhD applicants will require a minimum 85% over the final two years.

toefl_min.value: Neuroscience asks for TOEFL iBT 5, individual and overall, higher than the graduate-school 4.5.

ielts_min.value: Neuroscience asks for IELTS 7, higher than the graduate-school 6.5.
